items.title: GEHC Wins CE Mark for Photonova Spectra, Expands International Reach
items.summary: GE HealthCare's Photonova Spectra gains CE Mark, expanding access to its Deep Silicon photon-counting CT technology across Europe and other CE markets.

items.title: 1 of Wall Street’s Favorite Stocks for Long-Term Investors and 2 We Ignore
items.summary: Wall Street is overwhelmingly bullish on the stocks in this article, with price targets suggesting significant upside potential. However, it’s worth remembering that analysts rarely issue sell ratings, partly because their firms often seek other business from the same companies they cover.

items.title: 1 Mid-Cap Stock on Our Buy List and 2 Facing Headwinds
items.summary: Many investors pay attention to mid-cap stocks because they have established business models and expansive market opportunities. However, their paths to becoming $100 billion corporations are ripe with competition, ranging from giants with vast resources to agile upstarts eager to disrupt the status quo.

items.title: Stryker to Acquire ZuriMED to Expand Its Shoulder Care Portfolio
items.summary: SYK's planned ZuriMED acquisition adds the FiberLocker System, aiming to strengthen its shoulder portfolio and rotator cuff care capabilities.

items.title: TXG Stock Down Despite Patent Verdict Win Against Parse Biosciences
items.summary: 10x Genomics wins a $4.8M patent verdict against Parse, strengthening its IP position as it seeks added damages and a U.S. injunction.

items.title: GE HealthCare Unveils Next-Gen Vivid Cardiac Ultrasound Systems
items.summary: GEHC expands its Vivid cardiovascular ultrasound portfolio with three systems featuring AI tools and cSound imaging for varied care settings.

items.title: CVRx Secures Devoted Health Coverage for Barostim Therapy
items.summary: CVRX secures Devoted Health Medicare Advantage coverage for Barostim, expanding reimbursement access to about 466,000 members across 29 states.

items.title: Why Is Align Technology (ALGN) Down 8.4% Since Last Earnings Report?
items.summary: Align Technology (ALGN) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.
